content: {"paper_id":"W3157960931","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"label-distribution-learning","exact_quote":"A novel FEA method based on intensity label distribution learning is presented","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"摘要提出基于强度标签分布学习的FEA方法，以分布作为监督同时识别表情类别并估计强度水平，满足标记分布学习定义。"},{"keyword_id":"label-enhancement","exact_quote":"the intensity label distribution is generated for each frame in the expression sequence using a linear interpolation estimation and a Gaussian function to address the lack of reasonable annotations for expression intensity","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"为缓解表情强度标注不足，先为每帧生成强度标签分布，属于从粗/缺标签构建更细致标签分布。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","reason_zh":"摘要仅说明强度标注缺乏并用插值与高斯生成标签分布，未明确将不完整/不精确监督作为学习设定；证据不足以判定为弱监督学习。"}],"input_issues":[]}
